content: To assess the quality of the resulting cross-lingual datasets, we have conducted a verification experiment similar to Vulic:2019acl. We randomly sampled 300 concept pairs in the English-Spanish, English-French, and English-Mandarin cross-lingual datasets. Subsequently, we asked bilingual native speakers to provide similarity judgments of each pair. The Spearman's correlation score $\rho $ between automatically induced and manually collected ratings achieves $\rho \ge 0.90$ on all samples, which confirms the viability of the automatic construction procedure.
